title: Add generated-article divergence verification
description:
# Add generated-article divergence verification

## Purpose

Make the pod-to-CMS canonicality rule mechanical rather than dependent on operator memory.

## Deliverables

- Add a deterministic verification command for marked pod-generated Anth.us files.
- Regenerate or otherwise compare each marked file with its pod source.
- Fail with the affected article and recovery action when divergence exists.
- Ignore the existing hand-authored blog corpus unless a file carries the generated marker.
- Integrate the verification into the Anth.us continuous-integration path under that repository workflow.

## Implements

- PPY-54923a: divergence detection.

## Verification

CI-oriented executable scenarios pass for matching output, fail for a deliberate generated-file edit, and leave unmarked posts outside the contract.
